_note: Weight of the talent effects on the view (src/vfx/talent_fx.gd take_feel), by importance: per tier the crypt's shake trauma (0..1, src/vfx/feedback.gd), the story worlds' shake in px (hell_game state.shake), a hold of the picture (hitstop, s) for the hero's own casts only, and a bloom flash in the element's colour (flash s, flash_r art cells). Events pick a tier; an ultimate's cast and its waves weigh most, each bought stage a bit more (stage_bonus). Client-side pools of the ultimates (pools): material, radius as a share of the hit radius (or art cells), length in s (0 = as long as the ultimate's buff). aura_glow: bloom strength of a lasting buff on the hero. Game feel review 2026-10-30 (production/qa/evidence/talent-vfx-review). The Elementsprache (docs/ZAUBER-SPRACHE.de.md, 2026-10-31): shots (flight language per tier, impact size, the tier of each shot talent, the feel tier of an impact), cast (the CAST beat: element pixels gathering at the hand), residue (what an element leaves on the floor after an impact or a zone's end: a pool material with its radius in art cells per shot tier [small, huge] or as a share of a zone's radius, and how long it lies [min, max] s; elements without a pool leave settled chips only) and traps (the pixel traps' sizes). Fire overhaul (user feedback 2026-10-31: the fire mage's attacks looked weak, no pixel animation, the Flammenmeer drawn as lines): the fire section below carries the Feuermagier's own language (a white-hot heart, an ember tail, the fat explosion in pushes, the Flammenmeer's tongues and smoke, the spear's shimmer and lava, the chain's burning, the meteor's crater, the phoenix's fire trail); shots.talent_feel and residue.talent_residue let a talent override its tier's feel and its element's residue material.

pools._note: Legacy table of the old ultimates (fire_6 ...): the ultimates were renumbered to <spec>_14 and their residue now comes from the residue table like every other talent's. Kept for hosts that still read it.

dome._note: The shields as a rubber dome over the hero (src/vfx/talent_dome.gd). sizes: [W base half width, D base half depth, H height over the feet] in art cells for a guard flash, a shield (Kristallschild, Schutzwall, Wächtereid) and Unbezwingbar; the hero is about 16 x 28 cells. spring pulls each outline point back (1/s^2), damping slows it (1/s; low = wobbly), tension ties neighbours so a dent runs round as a wave, keep_volume (1/s) pushes the rest out when one side dents, push = a blow's speed into the dome (cells/s at power 1), max_dent a share of W, squash_* the whole dome's squash and spring back. User request 2026-10-30: a rubber dome that gives on the side an arrow hits and springs back.

shots._note: FLIGHT and IMPACT by tier: core = radius of the shot's core ball in art cells, trail = cells of dithered element trail behind it, burst = reach of the painted impact burst in art cells, parts = particles the impact throws (sparks, shards, drops, motes or chips by the element's kind), crack = floor cracks it leaves (0 none), glow = bloom radius of the shot in art cells. talent_tier: the tier of each shot talent (others: small). feel: the feel tier (tiers above) an impact of a shot tier has (empty: none). fizzle_tol: a shot that vanishes within this many crypt px of where it was predicted is a hit; its last position is where it struck. talent_feel: a shot talent's own feel tier (over feel by tier): fire_1 medium (the fat explosion), fire_9 large (the spear cracks the floor).

cast._note: The CAST beat: cells element pixels gather from reach art cells away at the caster's hand over span s (by tier; the cast event itself lasts 0.5 s), then a flash of flash cells. hand: the hand's offset from the chest along the aim in art cells. Tier of a cast: the shot tier of a shot talent, else by its talents.json type (kind_tier); an ultimate is huge.

residue._note: RESIDUE: what stays on the floor. Pool elements: st the pool material (vfx_pools.json), cells its radius in art cells for a shot impact by tier [small, huge] (linear between), share its radius as a share of a nova's or zone's hit radius (capped at cap art cells), time how long it lies [min, max] s (a zone's residue lasts zone_time). Elements without a pool (bone, steel, gold, soul, stone, beast, spirit, curse) leave settled chips only: chips per tier [small, huge]. A drawn line (Flammenmeer) leaves a pool every path_every points. Auto-attacks leave nothing; Giftpfeil (trapper_1) only at its impact. lava: the hot residue of the Infernospeer and the Meteor (talent_residue maps a talent to a residue key other than its element's; a zone's residue follows its talent too). The Flammenmeer leaves ash, not a pool (fire.flammenmeer).

traps._note: The pixel traps (src/vfx/talent_pixels.gd trap): kinds thorn (Dornenfalle: a ring of thorns dripping poison), iron (Explosionsfalle, Jagdgrund: an iron trap with an ember core), net (Netzfalle: a rope net). Inferred from the snapshot: boom (no root) = iron, else net when the trap radius is over net_over crypt px (Netzfalle 2 m, Dornenfalle 1 m), else thorn. radius: the drawn half width in art cells per kind, pulse: the armed pulse per s, spring: s the trigger burst plays.

fire._note: The Feuermagier's language (src/vfx/talent_fx.gd, talent_pixels.gd, talent_ults.gd; all sizes art cells, times s). heart: radius of the white-hot heart in a fire shot's core by shot tier (0 none); tail: cells of ember tail behind the ball that cool down the ramp and sag as they fall. boom (the fat explosion in pushes, TalentPixels.boom): time s the painted boom plays, flash the share of it the white flash frame holds, pulses pressure rings running out one after another within pulse_span of it, size [min, max] cells of the boom of an explosion event by its hit radius (size_share x r in cells), sparks [small, huge] glowing sparks the particles throw that bounce and lie as embers dying over lie [min, max] s (vfx_particles.json fire.ember_lie), scorch share of the reach the scorch star takes. spear (Infernospeer): length cells of the ember spear before and behind its point, shimmer cover of the heat haze beside it, crack branches the floor cracks into. flammenmeer: tongue [min, max] cells tall, every cells between tongues along the stroke, pool_every path points between the fire pools under it, pool_share of the stroke's half width a pool's radius takes, smoke_every s between smoke puffs, smoke_stride path points between them, smoke_r crypt px, ash s before the end the fire burns down to ash. chain (Glutkette): burn s the hit targets show flames, sparks the particles throw per link. meteor: shadow the darkness of the grown shadow (dither cover), size [min, max] cells of the landing's boom (size_share x r), lava_share of the crater radius its lava pool takes, chips rock chips the landing throws, smoke_every s between the crater's smoke puffs. phoenix (Phoenixschritt): trail s the fire along the dash burns, trail_every crypt px between its pools, trail_cells their radius, wings cells each ember wing spans.
